info.title: UbiquityOS AI Gateway API
info.description: The OpenAI-compatible inference API for AI.UBQ.FI. Authenticate with an approved UbiquityOS gateway token, query /v1/models before choosing a model, and use the published JSON error envelope and rate-limit fields for autonomous clients.

externalDocs.description: Developer portal, authentication guidance, and examples

tags.name: OpenAI compatibility
tags.description: OpenAI-shaped model discovery and inference endpoints.

tags.name: UbiquityOS extensions
tags.description: Documented gateway capabilities that are separate from the official OpenAI schema.

tags.name: Service discovery
tags.description: Public liveness and machine-readable service documentation.

get.description: Returns public release liveness only. It does not send an inference request, query provider health, or require a bearer token.

200.description: The active release is serving requests.

get.description: Without query parameters, returns the strict OpenAI-compatible model-list shape. Supplying one exact client_version uses the separate Codex-native compatibility contract and returns the richer upstream catalog for that client version; do not treat that versioned response as an official OpenAI schema.

200.description: The OpenAI-compatible list, or the documented Codex-native catalog when client_version is supplied.

304.description: For a matching If-None-Match request on the Codex-native client_version catalog: no response body; reuse the cached catalog.

post.description: Creates an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions response. Set stream to true for server-sent events. Function tools use the typed FunctionTool schema; select a model from GET /v1/models first.

200.description: A JSON chat-completion object when stream is false, or server-sent events when stream is true.

post.description: Creates an OpenAI-compatible Responses API result. The request body is required, but input is optional when the caller supplies instructions or a supported continuation context. Responses function tools use direct name, description, and parameters fields; the nested Chat Completions form is accepted only as a gateway compatibility extension. Set stream to true for OpenAI Responses server-sent events.

200.description: A JSON Responses object when stream is false, or OpenAI Responses server-sent events when stream is true.

post.description: Creates one or more images from a text prompt and returns the buffered OpenAI Images JSON response. This gateway does not currently expose streaming image events.

200.description: A buffered OpenAI Images response containing the requested generated images.

post.description: Creates one or more edited images from a prompt and source images. Use binary image and mask parts with multipart form data, or images and mask references with JSON.

200.description: A buffered OpenAI Images response containing the requested edited images.

get.description: Returns gateway metadata such as reasoning support and context-window limits. This extension is intentionally separate from the strict OpenAI /v1/models response.

200.description: Gateway-specific capabilities for the current model catalog.

get.description: Returns the public catalog the /models page renders: the operator's enabled models across the selected providers, with per-source status. It needs no bearer token and is not an OpenAI response shape; use GET /v1/models for the OpenAI-compatible list.

Reports which authentication path the presented credential resolved through (gateway token, KV API key, admin token, passkey session, or GitHub/kernel token), the auth mode, and a token fingerprint. It never returns the raw token. For a KV API key it adds key metadata and usage counters. Use it first when an integration fails.

post.description: Creates Voyage voyage-4-large text embeddings, cached in durable KV, in the OpenAI-style list shape. It is not a fully OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint: it accepts text only, rejects token arrays, and does not accept or map OpenAI embedding model names. Send input as an array to batch. An Idempotency-Key header enables durable replay.

200.description: One embedding per input string, in input order.

post.description: Creates an embeddings job. The gateway completes it immediately (200) or queues it (202, with Retry-After and retry_after_seconds) when Voyage is rate limited. Jobs require model voyage-4-large, an explicit input_type, and float encoding. Inputs are stored encrypted for up to 24 hours and deleted once the job completes.

200.description: The job finished: status is succeeded with a result, or failed with an error.

202.description: The job is queued or running. Poll GET /uos/embedding-jobs/{id} after Retry-After seconds.

get.description: Returns an embeddings job until its status is succeeded or failed. Jobs are scoped to the authenticated client identity: poll with credentials that resolve to the identity that created the job (the same API key, or for GitHub/kernel auth the same owner and repository attestation context).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id returned when the job was created.

200.description: The job finished: status is succeeded with a result, or failed with an error.

202.description: The job is still queued or running. Poll again after Retry-After seconds.

get.description: Lists agent messages stored for the repository and state named by the kernel attestation, oldest first. It requires a GitHub token as the bearer credential with kernel attestation headers; any other credential receives 403. Page with cursor, or resume from next_since.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only messages created at or after this Unix time in milliseconds.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The next_cursor from a previous page.

post.description: Stores one agent message for the repository and state named by the kernel attestation. It requires a GitHub token as the bearer credential with kernel attestation headers; any other credential receives 403. The server assigns id, created_at_ms, owner, repo, and state_id.

bearerAuth.description: An approved UbiquityOS gateway token. Obtain it through an authorized operator workflow; never paste it into prompts, source control, or a public URL.

ClientVersion.name: client_version
ClientVersion.description: An exact Codex CLI version. Supplying this field switches GET /v1/models to the separately documented Codex-native catalog contract.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Enables durable replay of the same embeddings request. Reusing a key with a different request returns 409.

GitHubOwner.name: X-GitHub-Owner
GitHubOwner.description: Optional cross-check. The kernel attestation names the repository; when X-GitHub-Owner and X-GitHub-Repo are both sent, they must equal the owner and repository it names.

GitHubRepo.name: X-GitHub-Repo
GitHubRepo.description: Optional cross-check. The kernel attestation names the repository; when X-GitHub-Owner and X-GitHub-Repo are both sent, they must equal the owner and repository it names.

KernelToken.name: X-Ubiquity-Kernel-Token
KernelToken.description: The UbiquityOS kernel attestation JWT for the GitHub token sent as the bearer credential.

GitHubInstallationId.name: X-GitHub-Installation-Id
GitHubInstallationId.description: Required when the kernel attestation includes installation_id.

ETag.description: The validator for a Codex-native client_version catalog. It is present on versioned 200 and 304 responses and is omitted from the unversioned OpenAI-compatible list.

RetryAfter.description: When present, seconds to wait before retrying a 429 response.

RateLimit.description: Structured field from active IETF draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers-11, emitted only when the gateway has an authoritative API-key request window. Example: "api-key";r=0;t=60.

RateLimitPolicy.description: Policy field from active IETF draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers-11, emitted for bounded gateway API keys. Example: "api-key";q=100;w=3600.

RateLimitLimit.description: Compatibility field for the request limit in the active API-key window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Compatibility field for requests remaining in the active API-key window.

RateLimitReset.description: Compatibility field for seconds until the active API-key window resets.

id.description: Model identifier accepted by inference routes.

ModelList.description: The strict OpenAI-compatible unversioned model-list response.

CodexNativeModelCatalog.description: The rich catalog returned only by GET /v1/models?client_version=X.Y.Z. Its records follow the supporting Codex client contract rather than the official OpenAI model-list schema.

ChatMessage.description: A Chat Completions message. Content may be text or a supported multimodal content array.

JsonSchema.description: A JSON Schema object used to validate function arguments. Use explicit properties, required fields, and additionalProperties: false whenever possible.

FunctionDefinition.description: A callable function definition for an LLM tool.

description.description: Clear instruction for when the model should call the function.

strict.description: Request strict argument generation when supported by the selected model.

FunctionTool.description: An OpenAI function tool. Tool execution remains the client's responsibility; never use a tool definition to disclose credentials.

ToolChoice.description: Controls whether and how the model may select a function tool.

ResponseFunctionTool.description: An OpenAI Responses function tool. Name, description, and parameters are direct properties. The gateway also accepts the nested Chat Completions function object as a compatibility extension, but clients should use this portable Responses shape.

description.description: Clear instruction for when the model should call the function.

strict.description: Request strict argument generation when supported by the selected model.

ResponseToolChoice.description: Controls whether and how the Responses API may select a function tool. A forced function choice uses a direct name property.

ChatCompletionRequest.description: An OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions request. The properties without x-uos-extension are exactly the request allowlist the gateway enforces, which matches the official CreateChatCompletionRequest schema at the pinned openai/openai-openapi revision checked by the spec:drift gate. Properties marked x-uos-extension are gateway compatibility extensions, not official OpenAI fields, and are accepted only on the routes they name. Any other property is rejected with 400 Unrecognized request argument supplied. An accepted field that the selected route does not apply is named in the x-uos-warning response header, for example temperature_ignored.

model.description: A model returned by GET /v1/models. Omit only when an operator-configured default is acceptable.

reasoning_effort.description: A tier advertised by the selected model catalog, or none.

max_completion_tokens.description: The OpenAI Chat Completions output-token cap. Its transport behavior depends on the selected route; see /llms-full.txt. Omit the field for no cap: null and values below 1 are rejected with 400.

prompt_cache_key.description: Forwarded as a prompt-cache routing hint. The gateway does not store or move an upstream prompt cache.

stream_options.description: Omit the field rather than sending null; null is outside this contract and most Chat routes reject it with 400.

user.description: Deprecated in favor of safety_identifier and prompt_cache_key.

thinking.description: DeepSeek thinking-mode switch: a DeepSeek compatibility extension, not an official OpenAI field. Accepted only when model selects the official DeepSeek route; every other model rejects it as an unrecognized argument.

cache_control.description: OpenRouter Claude prompt-cache control: an OpenRouter compatibility extension, not an official OpenAI field. Accepted only for an anthropic/claude- model served by the enabled OpenRouter provider; otherwise rejected as an unrecognized argument.

PromptCacheOptions.description: Prompt-cache options validated by the gateway.

ResponseInput.description: A Responses API input string or structured input-item array.

ResponseRequest.description: An OpenAI-compatible Responses API request. Input is optional so an approved continuation or instructions-only request can use the configured default behavior. The properties without x-uos-extension are exactly the request allowlist the gateway enforces, which matches the official CreateResponse schema at the pinned openai/openai-openapi revision checked by the spec:drift gate. Properties marked x-uos-extension are gateway compatibility extensions, not official OpenAI fields: client_metadata is the Codex CLI extension accepted on every Responses request, and cache_control is accepted only on the route it names. Any other property is rejected with 400 Unrecognized request argument supplied. An accepted field that the selected route does not apply is named in the x-uos-warning response header, for example temperature_ignored.

max_output_tokens.description: The OpenAI Responses output-token cap. Its transport behavior depends on the selected route; see /llms-full.txt.

prompt_cache_key.description: Forwarded as a prompt-cache routing hint. The gateway does not store or move an upstream prompt cache.

user.description: Deprecated in favor of safety_identifier and prompt_cache_key.

client_metadata.description: Codex CLI request metadata: a Codex CLI compatibility extension, not an official OpenAI field. Accepted on every /v1/responses request; every value must be a string.

cache_control.description: OpenRouter Claude prompt-cache control: an OpenRouter compatibility extension, not an official OpenAI field. Accepted only for an anthropic/claude- model served by the enabled OpenRouter provider; otherwise rejected as an unrecognized argument.

ChatCompletionResponse.description: A Chat Completions response. The concrete payload depends on the selected model and whether tools were called.

ResponseObject.description: A Responses API response. Output items can contain text, tool calls, and tool-call outputs according to the selected request.

ImageRef.description: One source image referenced by a non-empty image URL. File identifiers are unsupported because this gateway does not bind Files API identifiers to the selected upstream account.

image_url.description: A fully qualified HTTP(S) URL or supported base64 image data URL.

ImageMaskRef.description: One edit mask supplied as a base64 PNG data URL. Remote mask URLs are unsupported because the Responses image tool requires inline mask data and the gateway does not fetch caller-controlled URLs; file identifiers are unsupported because the gateway does not bind Files API identifiers to the selected upstream account.

image_url.description: A base64-encoded PNG data URL within the Images JSON reference limit.

ImageGenerationRequest.description: An OpenAI Images generation request. The gateway returns buffered JSON and does not accept stream, partial_images, or the DALL-E-only style option.

model.description: The image model. Omitted or null values use the hosted Responses image-generation tool default, gpt-image-1.

response_format.description: This buffered gateway returns base64 image data and therefore accepts only b64_json.

stream.description: Streaming image responses are not supported; omit this field or send false.

partial_images.description: Partial image streaming is not supported; this field may only be omitted or null.

user.description: An end-user identifier. The Codex-hosted primary transport cannot apply this field; when it is ignored, the response includes x-uos-warning: user_ignored.

ImageEditJsonRequest.description: An OpenAI Images edit request using source image URLs instead of binary multipart uploads. File identifiers are unsupported by this gateway.

model.description: The image model. Omitted or null values use the OpenAI Images edit default, gpt-image-1.5.

size.description: An image size accepted by the requested GPT Image model, including flexible gpt-image-2 resolutions.

stream.description: Streaming image responses are not supported; omit this field or send false.

partial_images.description: Partial image streaming is not supported; this field may only be omitted or null.

user.description: An end-user identifier. The Codex-hosted primary transport cannot apply this field; when it is ignored, the response includes x-uos-warning: user_ignored.

ImageEditMultipartRequest.description: An OpenAI Images edit request using up to sixteen binary uploads under image, image[], or both field names. Each source image and optional mask must be non-empty and smaller than 50 MiB; together they must total no more than 50 MiB.

model.description: The image model. Omitted or null values use the OpenAI Images edit default, gpt-image-1.5.

image.description: One or more PNG, JPEG, or WebP source files, each smaller than 50 MiB.

image[].description: One or more PNG, JPEG, or WebP source files, each smaller than 50 MiB.

mask.description: A non-empty PNG mask smaller than 50 MiB.

stream.description: Streaming image responses are not supported; omit this field or send false.

partial_images.description: Partial image streaming is not supported; this field may only be omitted or null.

user.description: An end-user identifier. The Codex-hosted primary transport cannot apply this field; when it is ignored, the response includes x-uos-warning: user_ignored.

Image.description: One generated image item in an OpenAI Images response.

ImagesResponse.description: The buffered OpenAI Images response returned for generation and edit requests.

ModelCapabilitiesResponse.description: Gateway-specific model capability metadata. This is not an official OpenAI response shape.

PublicModelCatalog.description: The public model catalog. This is not an official OpenAI response shape.

sources.description: Per-source status, entry count, and last update time.

token.description: A fingerprint of the presented token. The raw token is never returned.

EmbeddingsInput.description: One text string or an array of text strings. Token arrays are rejected.

EmbeddingsRequest.description: A UOS text-embeddings request. These properties are exactly the runtime allowlist; any other property is rejected with 400.

input_type.description: Send it explicitly for retrieval workloads.

EmbeddingJobRequest.description: An asynchronous UOS embeddings job request. These properties are exactly the runtime allowlist; any other property, user included, is rejected with 400.

EmbeddingsResponse.description: The OpenAI-style embeddings list. With encoding_format base64, each embedding is a base64 string of little-endian float32 values.

metadata.description: Any JSON object whose JSON encoding is at most 8000 characters.

next_since.description: created_at_ms of the last message on this page.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The OpenAI-style JSON error envelope returned for API failures. Read error.message for an actionable resolution hint and error.code for programmatic handling.

InvalidRequest.description: The request body, query, or model selection is invalid. Read error.message and error.param before changing the request.

Unauthorized.description: A valid bearer token is required. Obtain access through the authorized operator workflow; do not submit a token in a prompt.

RateLimited.description: A JSON rate-limit error. Honor Retry-After when present. RateLimit metadata is included only when the gateway has an authoritative bounded API-key request window.

Forbidden.description: The credential is valid but cannot use this route, for example a non-GitHub credential on /uos/agent-messages.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or belongs to another client identity.

IdempotencyConflict.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request, or its first request is still in progress.

UpstreamFailure.description: The gateway could not obtain a required upstream catalog response. Retry according to the returned JSON error.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The gateway or a required upstream dependency is temporarily unavailable. Read the JSON error and retry only when appropriate.
